name: cancel_aish_automation
purpose: Cancel one unfulfilled automation delivery (queued or dead-lettered). Does not cancel the job, schedule, or future slots. CAS on generation + totalAttempts.
useWhen: the owner or manager wants to stop a scheduled delivery before it runs
a dead-lettered delivery should not be retried
avoidWhen: the delivery already succeeded (use disposition instead)
the intent is to deactivate the whole schedule (no such tool yet)

name: close_aish_job_administratively
purpose: Administratively close a queued or expired-lease AISH job with an auditable closure outcome, clearing its terminal-issue mismatch signal.
useWhen: A queued AISH job is linked to an issue already done or canceled (outcome=obsolete or superseded)
A queued job was replaced by a governed retry (outcome=superseded)
A queued job's purpose was compensated by non-AISH delivery (outcome=compensated)
An expired-lease AISH job must be closed to unblock the workflow
avoidWhen: Job is completed: use set_aish_completed_job_disposition instead
Job is failed: use resolve_aish_failed_job instead
Job is running or has an active lease: wait for it to finish or expire
You only want to read the job: use get_aish_job

inputs.notes: AISH job id, max 160 chars
enum: superseded | compensated | obsolete | canceled
8-2000 chars

preconditions: Caller can manage the job's project
returns: Full job (get_aish_job shape). job.administrativeClosure = {outcome, reason, closedBy, closedAt, previousStatus, evidenceIdsSnapshot, linkedEvidenceId}; new manual-note evidence id appended to job.evidenceIds.

errors.fix: Use exactly superseded, compensated, obsolete, or canceled.

errors.when: AISH administrative closure reason is required.
errors.fix: Send a reason of at least 8 characters.
Re-check jobId with list_aish_jobs.

errors.when: Only queued or expired leased AISH jobs can be administratively closed.
errors.fix: Check status with get_aish_job. Completed jobs use set_aish_completed_job_disposition; failed jobs use resolve_aish_failed_job.

gotchas.text: The job status changes to canceled after closure.
Workflow reconciliation is triggered after closure.

name: resolve_aish_failed_job
purpose: Resolve a failed AISH job with an auditable resolution outcome (compensated, historical, or ignored), clearing its terminal-issue mismatch signal.
useWhen: A failed AISH job is linked to an issue already done (outcome=historical: issue was delivered by another path)
A failed job's work was compensated by a successful replacement (outcome=compensated)
A failed job's failure is acceptable and should be recorded as ignored (outcome=ignored)
avoidWhen: Job is completed: use set_aish_completed_job_disposition instead
Job is queued: use close_aish_job_administratively instead
Job is running: wait for it to finish
You only want to read the job: use get_aish_job

inputs.notes: AISH job id, max 160 chars
enum: compensated | historical | ignored
8-2000 chars

preconditions: Caller can manage the job's project
returns: Full job (get_aish_job shape). job.failureResolution = {outcome, reason, resolvedBy, resolvedAt, evidenceIdsSnapshot}; new manual-note evidence id appended to job.evidenceIds.

errors.when: Invalid AISH failed job resolution outcome.
errors.fix: Use exactly compensated, historical, or ignored.

errors.when: AISH failed job resolution reason is required.
errors.fix: Send a reason of at least 8 characters.
Re-check jobId with list_aish_jobs.

errors.when: Only failed AISH jobs can be resolved.
errors.fix: Check status with get_aish_job. Completed jobs use set_aish_completed_job_disposition; queued jobs use close_aish_job_administratively.
